column1: # boru Language Specification: the boru:query module
# Loadable SQL-style query DSL. Import binds the `Query` namespace:
# The pipeline is LAZY: `select` seeds a query, later words attach
# clauses, and it only runs when materialized (printed / iterated /
# canonicalised). `from` resolves its source table by name from the
# context store. A self-contained spec row has no Go-registered table,
# so these rows seed and chain each clause word and let the sourceless
# query canonicalise to the empty table `[]` — proving each word parses,
# dispatches through its module wrapper, accepts its declared argument
# shape, and composes into the pipeline. The `from`-with-a-real-table
# path is exercised by the Go suite (modules/query_test.go); here it is

column3: ORDER BY attaches a sort clause
USING joins on a shared column
FROM resolves the source by name; absent table errors
